how_to_apply: Visit the official Narayanpur Police website at narayanpur.cgpolice.gov.in.
Locate the Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026 notification and application form.
Download or obtain the prescribed six-page notification and application form.
Read the district residence, educational qualification, age and physical eligibility requirements.
Enter your name in Hindi and English, date of birth, gender, parents' names, mobile number and other required personal details.
Enter educational qualifications, marks, passing years and other relevant information.
Provide the required present and permanent address details.
Enter category, local residence, Ex-Serviceman, Home Guard or other applicable special status information.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph as instructed.
Attach self-attested copies of educational, residence, category, age and other applicable supporting certificates.

important_instructions: The recruitment is for 383 Fighter Constable posts in Narayanpur district. Only eligible local residents of Narayanpur district can apply. Applications are accepted offline from 2 November to 12 December 2026. The application receipt deadline is 12 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. General, OBC and SC candidates require the prescribed 10th Pass qualification. Eligible ST candidates and notified special-category applicants may apply with 5th Pass qualification. Age is calculated as on 1 January 2026. Applicants must meet the prescribed height, chest and other physical standards. Selection includes a Physical Efficiency Test, written examination and interview. Bonus marks are available only under the stated eligibility conditions. Applications may be submitted at the designated police offices or sent by registered post. Incomplete applications or applications without necessary supporting documents may be rejected. Selection test dates will be communicated separately by the department. Candidates should check official Narayanpur Police and Chhattisgarh Police websites for future instructions.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Narayanpur Police recruitment notification announces 383 Fighter Constable vacancies , with the largest number of posts reserved for Scheduled Tribe candidates. The department may revise the advertised vacancies according to instructions issued by the Chhattisgarh Government and Police Headquarters.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Official Recruitment Notices: View Narayanpur Police Recruitment Website

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be local residents of Narayanpur district and possess the prescribed educational qualification. The notification provides lower qualification requirements for Scheduled Tribe candidates and certain notified families affected by Naxal violence. Important: The 5th Pass eligibility is not available to all candidates. It applies only to the categories and special circumstances specified in the official notification. Candidates must possess the relevant supporting certificates when claiming these provisions. The recruitment is restricted to applicants who are local residents of Narayanpur district . Candidates must submit the prescribed residence certificate issued by the competent authority. Applicants from other districts should not assume eligibility for the Narayanpur vacancies merely because they are residents of Chhattisgarh.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The notification also provides special age-related provisions for eligible serving Government employees, certain former Government employees, Home Guards and other notified categories. Eligible Chhattisgarh Government employees and certain other employees may receive age concessions under the prescribed service conditions. The notification specifies a 36-year age ceiling for certain eligible Government employment categories. Certain dismissed Government employees and former employees who left service may be eligible for the specific relaxation provided in the notice. Additional concessions, where applicable, are governed by the recruitment rules. Candidates should verify the combined effect of age relaxations under the official recruitment rules before applying, rather than automatically adding different concessions together.

rows.details: Up to 10 Years under the Notified Rules

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Physical Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the minimum height and chest measurements specified for their category and gender. The notice also requires medical fitness, including acceptable eyesight and the absence of specified physical defects. Important: Chest measurement is not applicable to female candidates. Male candidates must meet the prescribed minimum expansion of 5 cm. Candidates must not have knock knees or flat feet. Applicants must possess medically acceptable eyesight. Eye defects and other disqualifying medical conditions will be assessed under the notified recruitment rules. Final determination of physical eligibility will be made by the competent selection or medical authority.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Salary and allowances will be governed by the applicable Chhattisgarh Government and Chhattisgarh Police Special Executive Force recruitment rules. Candidates should refer to the latest official pay instructions before relying on a particular salary amount.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates should follow the official notification and any subsequent departmental instructions. No unverified fee amount or exemption should be assumed.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The notified selection procedure includes physical measurement, a Physical Efficiency Test, written examination and interview , followed by the applicable verification and final selection procedures. Application Scrutiny: Checking the prescribed educational qualification, age, residence and other eligibility conditions. Physical Measurement: Verification of height, chest measurement for male candidates and prescribed medical standards. Physical Efficiency Test: Assessment of the notified physical events. Written Examination: Examination of general knowledge, intelligence, reasoning, analytical ability and related subjects. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Bonus Marks: Awarded to eligible candidates possessing the specifically recognized certificates or qualifications. Final Selection: Preparation of the merit list under the applicable recruitment and reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test carries 100 marks . It includes different events designed to assess the candidate's physical ability and fitness. All candidates are required to participate in the prescribed physical events. Candidates who do not meet the applicable qualifying standards will not proceed under the notified selection conditions. The written examination carries 50 marks and covers subjects including General Knowledge, Intelligence, Reasoning, Analytical Ability and General Studies. The interview carries a maximum of 20 marks . Candidates will be shortlisted according to the notified selection procedure. The recognized certificate must be possessed by the application closing date. Bonus marks will be awarded only after verification of eligibility and the relevant certificate.

content_sections.heading: Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Application Form 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted through an offline application process . Eligible candidates must obtain the prescribed Bastar Fighter Constable application form, fill it out carefully and attach the required self-attested certificates. Official Recruitment Information: Narayanpur District Police Website Chhattisgarh Police Website: cgpolice.gov.in Application Period: 2 November to 12 December 2026. The prescribed application form is included in the six-page recruitment document. Applicants must fill out the form clearly and sign the required declaration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Narayanpur Police website at narayanpur.cgpolice.gov.in . Locate the Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026 notification and application form. Download or obtain the prescribed six-page notification and application form. Read the district residence, educational qualification, age and physical eligibility requirements. Print the prescribed application form. Enter your name in Hindi and English, date of birth, gender, parents' names, mobile number and other required personal details. Enter educational qualifications, marks, passing years and other relevant information. Provide the required present and permanent address details. Enter category, local residence, Ex-Serviceman, Home Guard or other applicable special status information. Affix a recent passport-size photograph as instructed. Attach self-attested copies of educational, residence, category, age and other applicable supporting certificates. Complete and sign the application declaration. Submit the completed application in person at one of the designated police offices or send it by registered post. Ensure that the application reaches the designated office by 12 December 2026 at 5:00 PM . Retain the application acknowledgement or registered post receipt for future reference. Important: Applications submitted by post must be sent through registered post with acknowledgement. Candidates should not rely on the posting date alone; the application must be received by the specified deadline.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Application Submission Address
content_sections.text: Applicants can submit the completed form in person at any of the following three designated offices during working hours: Office of the Superintendent of Police, District Narayanpur. Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Chhotedongar. Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Benur. To, The Superintendent of Police, District Narayanpur, Chhattisgarh - 494661. Last Date for Receipt: 12 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach the required supporting certificates applicable to their eligibility and reservation claims. The prescribed application form also requests details of educational qualifications, identity, residence and special categories. Completed and signed Bastar Fighter Constable application form. Recent passport-size photograph, not older than three months, as instructed in the form. Age or date-of-birth proof. 10th Pass or applicable 5th Pass certificate and marksheet. Local residence certificate for Narayanpur district. Valid caste or community certificate, if applicable. Aadhaar Card or Voter ID details. Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence, if claiming the applicable bonus marks. NCC 'C' or NSS 'C' certificate, if claiming bonus marks. Ex-Serviceman or Ex-Agniveer certificate, where applicable. Home Guard service certificate, if applicable. Certificate supporting the notified Naxal-affected family or relief camp eligibility, if applicable. No Objection Certificate for eligible serving Government employees, where required. Other documents required by the application form or recruitment rules. Candidates must ensure that the supporting certificates match the information entered in the application. Documents related to bonus marks must satisfy the notified deadline and validity conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Office of the Superintendent of Police, Narayanpur, has announced 383 Bastar Fighter Constable vacancies, including 268 ST, 53 OBC, 42 UR and 20 SC posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of offline applications is 12 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. When will Narayanpur Bastar Fighter application submission begin?
faq.answer: Offline application submission begins on 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General, OBC and SC candidates must have passed 10th standard, while eligible ST and other specially notified candidates may qualify with 5th Pass under the recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as on 1 January 2026, with applicable relaxation for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates from other districts apply for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The notified vacancies are restricted to eligible local residents of Narayanpur district.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection includes physical measurement, a 100-mark Physical Efficiency Test, a 50-mark written examination and a 20-mark interview, with applicable bonus marks under the notified rules.

faq.question: Q8. Can female candidates apply for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible female candidates can apply, subject to the applicable reservation, age, educational and physical fitness requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an online application for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Applications must be submitted offline using the prescribed form, either in person at designated police offices or by registered post.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their Bastar Fighter application form?
faq.answer: Registered post applications should be addressed to the Superintendent of Police, District Narayanpur, Chhattisgarh - 494661.
